latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of skill-experience-layer:
- Adds per-skill, layered experience memory with pre-call mistake checking and error-driven learning.
- Automatically records mistakes and best practices for each skill to avoid repeating errors.
- Integrates with self-improving and capability-evolver for continuous, automated improvement.
- Designed to fit existing memory hierarchy and supports preventive learning before skill invocation.
- Ensures safe operation: only modifies experience files; never touches core or sensitive system files.
